item.title: The Mirrorless System
item.description:
Camera Body：EOS R8 (461g, with battery and memory card)

Lens：

  • rf28mm f/2.8 (120g) ultra-light pancake lens, effortless for daily photo walks
  • rf14-35mm f/4 L IS (540g) wide-angle, for landscapes, cityscapes and street
  • rf100-400mm f/5.6-8 IS (635g) telephoto, for sports, distant mountains and wildlife
  • rf85 f2 IS (500g) for portraits and macro

Future:

  • rf28-70mm f/2.8 IS (495g) or rf24-105mm f/4 L IS (700g) standard zoom, for travel
